typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	Archive_location as string (),
	Archive_path as string (),
	CountyResultSet as string (),
	COUNTY_CODE as string (),
	COUNTY_CRITERIA as string (),
	COUNTY_NAME as string (),
	EMAIL_RECIPIENTS as string (),
	FILENAME as string (),
	FILENAME_TEMPLATE as string (),
	Month_name as string (),
	Outbound_location as string (),
	Record_count as integer (),
	Report_Run_Date as timestamp (),
	STATUS_FLAG as integer (),
	Template_path as string ()
}

source(output(
		{Medi-Cal Member CIN} as string,
		{Eligibility Status} as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SELECT	[Medi-Cal Member CIN],[Eligibility Status]  FROM	##CA_REBID_POP_HLTH_FINAL		SRC INNER JOIN ##CA_REBID_POP_HLTH_EMAIL_CC	TMP ON		TMP.COUNTY_NAME					= SRC.COUNTY_NAME AND		TMP.Status_Flag					= 1',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> OLEDBSource
OLEDBSource sink(input(
		{Medi-Cal_Member_CIN_} as string,
		Column_1 as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		{Medi-Cal_Member_CIN_} = {Medi-Cal Member CIN},
		Column_1 = {Eligibility Status})) ~> FlatFileDestination
